samples.summary: Unrequested scope: compactCell now carries the four spill fields (plus a new spill test file). Issue #845's todo says nothing about dynamic-array spill metadata; this is a separate latent bug in the style-write path bundled into the decimals change, and neither docs/design/sheets/sheet-style.md nor docs/design/sheets/calculator.md (which owns spillRows/spillAnchor) records the new rule that style rewrites preserve spill fields.
samples.evidence: compactCell gains spillRows/spillCols/spillAnchor/spillBlocked pass-through; the docs hunk only covers unset + decimals semantics.

samples.summary: New private selectionTargets() duplicates the existing `this.ranges.length > 0 ? this.ranges : [this.getRangeOrActiveCell()]` idiom already inlined at sheet.ts:3736 (setRangeStyle) and :3757 (resetRangeStyleToDefault); the helper was added without folding those call sites into it, so the rule now exists in three copies.
samples.evidence: sheet.ts:3736-3738 and 3757-3759 repeat the identical expression.

samples.summary: Layer-abstraction departure: setRangeStyle deliberately writes only the column/row/sheet layer for column/row/all selections and never iterates cells (documented in sheet-style.md 'Write Semantics'). The new unset path, plus selectionRendersAt and unsetKeepsRendering, calls store.getGrid over every selection range regardless of selection type, so one select-all Decrease-decimals click does a whole-sheet cell scan with a per-cell formatValue comparison. The design doc does not address this scale cost.
samples.evidence: selectionRendersAt / unsetKeepsRendering / unsetRangeStyleValues each loop `for (const range of this.selectionTargets()) { const grid = await this.store.getGrid(range); ... }`, including for selectionType 'all'.

samples.summary: Partial fit with the issue outcome ('leave a cell exactly as it started'): emptying a column/row/sheet layer stores `{}` instead of removing the entry, so a column/row/sheet round trip leaves a residual empty layer rather than the original state — the diff's own tests weaken to `style?.dp === undefined` instead of `style === undefined` there. Documented as a deviation, but the Store-interface gap (no delete for those layers) is left unaddressed rather than fixed at the store layer.
samples.evidence: Doc: 'Removing the last key from a column/row/sheet layer stores `{}` rather than deleting the entry'; see the 'should round trip a column selection' test in packages/sheets/test/sheet/decimals.test.ts.

samples.evidence: omitStyleKeys added next to mergeStylePatch in range-styles.ts.
